Oneironautics is the practice of navigating dreams. This oneironautics portal is a catalogue of information which may be useful for dream navigators (oneironauts) to gain lucidity in their dreams. It attempts to approach the field from a rational and evidence-based perspective to separate it from the misinformation which surrounds the subject.
